The Canvas simulation in this directory is adapted from [stackedlol/ascii-sharks](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks), pinned to commit `a0074c16a106f0abc665fe9712ca445f8f98ad8e`.

The upstream project is distributed under the MIT License in `LICENSE`. The renderer is adapted to use NodeDance theme colors, a transparent background, and complete fish silhouettes.
